desc: Parse the input string into a tree structure representing the valid parenthesis sequence.
Implement the decomposition of the string into primitive components.
Count the occurrences of each unique component.
Compute the multinomial coefficient for the permutations using modular arithmetic.
Run the code against Sample 1: Input `6\n(())()` -> Expected Output `2`.
Run the code against Sample 2: Input `2\n()` -> Expected Output `1`.
Verify logic with a custom case like `()()()` (Expected 1) and `((()))` (Expected 1).
